decisions.reason: A hearty bread loaf fits the firm's core bakery business and is the kind of staple product a German food manufacturer would usually retain unless sales were clearly weak.
A guided historic mill tour is peripheral to food manufacturing and is more likely to be cut if management wants to focus resources on core products and new food development.
A sweet pastry is close to the firm's established product range and would typically be kept on the market unless it noticeably underperformed.
